Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.text: Sunita says this call is about painting work.
Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.quote: Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon. Sharma ji ne aapka number diya tha, painting ke liye.

Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bat.text: Ramesh says hello and asks what work is needed.
Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bat.quote: Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bataya tha. Boliye, kya kaam hai?

Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.text: Sunita says the job is to paint her whole 2BHK flat in Indirapuram, including both bedrooms, the hall, the kitchen, and the balcony grill.
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.value: paint whole 2BHK flat, including both bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and balcony grill
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.quote: Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Poora flat paint karwana hai - dono bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur balcony ki grill bhi.

Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.text: The worker asks whether the ceiling should also be painted or only the walls.
Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.quote: Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya sirf walls?

Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.text: The hirer says the job includes ceiling work too.
The hirer says one bedroom also needs putty because of dampness.
Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.quote: Aur ek bedroom mein thodi seelan hai, wahan putty bhi lagegi.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.text: The worker says the damp wall will first get putty and primer, then two coats.
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.value: putty and primer first, then two coats on the damp wall
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe pehle putty aur primer, phir do coat.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.text: The worker asks whether to use normal emulsion or premium paint.
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Paint kaunsa lagwana hai, normal emulsion ya premium wala?

Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.text: The hirer says the paint should be normal emulsion.
Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.quote: Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emulsion theek hai. Material aap laoge ya main mangwaun?

Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.text: The worker says he will bring the material himself.
Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.quote: Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tension nahi leni.

Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.text: The worker says he will tell the combined price for labour and material.
Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.quote: Labour aur material mila ke bata deta hoon.

Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?.text: The hirer asks what the total cost will be.
Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?.quote: Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?

Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam b.text: The worker says the total price for labour and material together is 28,000 rupees.
Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam b.quote: Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam bhi hai... labour material sab mila ke 28 hazaar lagega.

Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.text: Sunita says 28,000 rupees is too much.
Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.quote: Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar 20 mein poora ghar hua tha.

Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.text: Sunita says the whole house was done for 20,000 rupees last time.
Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.quote: Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar 20 mein poora ghar hua tha.

Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Ch.text: The worker says the price is now 25,000 rupees and he will not go lower.
Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Ch.quote: Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Chaliye aapke liye 25 kar deta hoon, isse kam nahi hoga.

24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.text: The hirer offers 24,000 rupees as a final total price.
24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.quote: 24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahiye.

Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.text: Ramesh accepts 24,000 rupees as the final total.
Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.quote: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.text: Ramesh states that labour, material, and putty are all included in the 24,000 rupees.
Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.quote: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?.text: The hirer accepts the worker's 24,000 rupees final price.
The hirer asks how much advance is needed.

Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.text: The worker says the advance should be 8,000 rupees before starting work.
Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.quote: Material lana padega na madam, to 8 hazaar advance de dijiye, kaam shuru karne se pehle.

8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.text: Sunita accepts the 8,000 rupee advance proposed just before and says she will pay it by GPay in the morning on the day the work starts.
8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.quote: 8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shuru karoge us din subah GPay kar dungi.

Ji bilkul, chalega..text: Worker says 8,000 rupees advance is fine.

Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle h.text: The hirer asks when the work will start.
Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle h.quote: Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle hafte mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain.

Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..text: The worker says the work will start on Monday.
Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..quote: Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon.

Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..text: The worker says he will add two more boys as well.
Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..quote: Do ladke aur lagaunga saath mein.

Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.text: The worker says the work starts Monday and finishes by Friday evening.
Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.quote: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jay.text: The hirer recalls that the work was said to finish on Friday.
Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jay.quote: Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jayenge, uske baad nahi chalega.

Pakka madam, Friday shaam tak. Aap befik.text: Worker Ramesh accepts Friday evening as the finish time.

Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.text: The hirer asks what happens if the work is not done by Friday.
Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.quote: Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to?

Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.text: The hirer says a previous contractor delayed a job by two weeks.
Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.quote: Pichhli baar ek contractor ne do hafte latka diya tha.

Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hu.text: The worker says if the work is late, the hirer may deduct 500 rupees for each day.
Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hu.value: 500 rupees per day deducted if late
Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hu.quote: Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hua to har din ka 500 rupaye kaat lena aap.

Ji madam, zubaan di hai..text: The worker says he has given his word.

Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.text: The hirer accepts the 500 rupees per day late penalty.
Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.quote: Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakhna.

Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.text: The hirer says to remember it.
Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.quote: Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakhna.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.text: The hirer accepts the agreed finish Friday evening and says to come Monday morning at 9.
Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.text: The hirer says to come Monday morning at 9.
Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.text: The hirer says the address will be sent on WhatsApp.
Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Ji madam, 9 baje pahunch jaunga. Dhanyav.text: The worker says he will arrive at 9 o'clock.
Ji madam, 9 baje pahunch jaunga. Dhanyav.quote: Ji madam, 9 baje pahunch jaunga. Dhanyavaad.

Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.text: The hirer says they will meet Monday.
Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.quote: Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko milte hain. Bye.
